rows: Describe your approach to implementing AEM Sites.

Our approach
- We would deliver this with AEM Sites.

What we would do
- We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template, with Core Components, editable templates, client-side libraries and the custom components the design needs.
- We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager, set up Git access and the first deployment pipelines.
- We will train authors to edit pages and content in the Universal Editor and hand over authoring guides for the site's components and templates.

After launch
- Each month we will ship code through Cloud Manager pipelines, check the automatic AEM version updates, review logs and the Developer Console, and fix issues found after go-live.
How would you connect CJA to Brand Visibility?

Our approach
- Brand Visibility sends aggregate AI-agent activity (from CDN logs, by URL and host) into CJA through an Experience Platform source. AI-referred visits and conversions come from CJA's own web data, and Brand Visibility reads those results for its business impact view.
- Four separate measures. AI-agent activity (from CDN logs) and monitored visibility (tracked prompts) are what Brand Visibility adds; AI-referred visits and conversions come from your CJA web data, which ordinary referrer reporting can show without it; lift comes only from a test. The data is aggregate: nothing ties a person to an AI mention.

What we would do
- We will configure the supported ABV bot-data connection and map URLs and hosts; identify AI-referred visits in the existing CJA web data with a derived field on AI referring domains; and align observed AI-referral and conversion measures with existing CJA data.
- We will configure the agreed monitoring portfolio (200 to 1,000 prompts in up to three markets or languages), validate access for up to 10 pilot users, confirm the delivery-network setup and register CDN log forwarding in Brand Visibility and confirm the logs arrive once the log-forwarding job is active in your CDN console, and record one baseline for the agreed prompts and three competitors.
- We will design the XDM schemas, create the datasets and set up ingestion for the channels CJA will report on, such as web, app, call center and point of sale data.
